title: storage.usage
description: What the app's files use on disk, by category: detections, shot_cuts, transcodes, look_previews, thumbnails, download_cache (the setup's own downloads), unfinished_renders, model_leftovers (partial and set-aside model files), models, outputs, catalog, logs, stats, benchmarks, run_keys (with the file hashes), and when present previous_cache (a cache folder used before cache_dir moved it; costly, since it holds detections) and shared_download_cache (uv's shared default, left by an older setup). policy says what removing it costs: safe (made again when needed, quickly), costly (slow to get back: detections and shot cuts are made again when needed, slowly; benchmarks are never made again, only Optimize measures again), resume (unfinished work redone), shared and kept (listed only). disks is free space per kind of folder as hw.detect gives it; cache_source says where the cache folder comes from (variable: BETASUITE_CACHE_DIR, setting: cache_dir, default); busy is true while a job holds the queue. No paths.
